subject: general
question: What is the aim of the recently launched Sujala Project in Karnataka?

options.text: To combat drought and recharge groundwater

solution:
The correct answer is __**To combat drought and recharge groundwater.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Karnataka government launched the Sujala Project to address drought conditions and improve groundwater levels through a watershed program.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Karnataka has 79% drought-prone land, making it the second most affected state after Rajasthan.**
 
• The Sujala Project focuses on increasing water table levels and improving agricultural productivity.
 
• The Watershed Yatra, launched on February 5, raises awareness about watershed development and conservation.
 
• It includes activities like essay competitions, processions, and community awareness drives in Tumkuru, Mandya, and Chickballapur.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
